mapper.sql: select i.invite_id, i.company_dept_id, i.dept_id, i.token_hash, i.invite_code, i.register_mode, i.status, i.expire_time, i.use_count, i.use_limit, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.last_use_time, i.remark, d.dept_name as dept_name, c.dept_name as company_name from sys_dept_register_invite i left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = i.dept_id left join sys_dept c on c.dept_id = i.company_dept_id
mapper.select: where i.dept_id = #{deptId} and i.status = '0' order by i.invite_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_dept_register_invite set status = '1' where dept_id = #{deptId} and status = '0'
update sys_dept_register_invite set use_count = ifnull(use_count, 0) + 1, last_use_time = sysdate() where invite_id = #{inviteId}
